title: A small HER2 reader for routine H&E slides: real-world deployment
abstract: arXiv:2610.40662v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: HER2 status decides who receives HER2-targeted therapy. Pathologists score HER2 protein by immunohistochemistry (IHC); equivocal IHC 2+ tumours, their hardest calls, wait for in situ hybridisation (ISH). We built a HER2 reader for routine H&E slides, owned end to end, as a baseline for pathologists. A 22M-parameter ViT-S/16 tile encoder was trained on public TCGA slides by self-supervision, distillation from H-optimus-0 and two rounds of JEPA refinement; five cross-validated attention-based slide classifiers average their probabilities; and an operating point is fixed on training data. Compared under one paired ten-seed protocol, readers on our encoder rank first of 7 on external validation from TCGA-BRCA to Yale-HER2 (AUC 0.812), level with readers on encoders 4 and 50 times larger. We also rebuilt PathBench's encoder benchmark on public cohorts; our replica reproduces its published order of reference encoders, and under it our encode

translated_title: 面向常规H&E切片的小型HER2判读器：真实世界部署
translated_abstract: HER2状态决定了哪些患者接受HER2靶向治疗。病理医生通过免疫组化（IHC）对HER2蛋白进行评分；而IHC 2+的临界病例——这是最难判断的情况——则需等待原位杂交（ISH）检测结果。我们构建了一个可直接读取常规H&E切片的HER2判读器，实现端到端自主可控，作为病理医生的基线工具。该模型采用2200万参数的ViT-S/16切片块编码器，在公开的TCGA切片上通过自监督学习、从H-optimus-0蒸馏以及两轮JEPA精炼进行训练；五个经交叉验证的基于注意力机制的切片分类器对其预测概率取平均；并在训练数据上固定了操作点。在一项配对的十种子协议下进行比较，基于我们编码器的判读器在从TCGA-BRCA到Yale-HER2的外部验证中位列7个方法之首（AUC 0.812），与基于4倍和50倍更大编码器的判读器性能持平。我们还在公开队列上重建了PathBench的编码器基准；我们的复现结果再现了其已发表的参考编码器排序，且在此基准下我们的编码器……
tldr: 研究者构建了一个仅2200万参数的小型HER2判读器，可直接从常规H&E染色切片预测HER2状态，在外部验证中位列7个方法之首（AUC 0.812），性能与体积大4倍和50倍的编码器持平，并已实现真实世界部署，可作为病理医生评估HER2状态的基线工具。
